# Frank Caron

> Frank Caron is a technical product and solutions architect and writer based in New York City, with a background in sales engineering and product. He has over a decade of experience leading product strategy, product marketing, and sales engineering at companies including Salesforce, Reach, Achievers, and others. He has shipped more than $500M in product and closed more than $85M as a sales engineer. He has been writing publicly since 2013, with bylines including Ars Technica.

## About

- **Name:** Frank Caron
- **Location:** New York City, NY, USA
- **Profession:** Technical Product & Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Writer
- **Email:** frank@frankcaron.com
- **Website:** https://www.frankcaron.com/

## Professional Background

Frank Caron's career spans solutions architecture, sales engineering, technical product strategy, and product marketing. He is known for combining deep technical fluency (software development, APIs, CRM systems, marketing automation) with strong communication and writing skills. He has held senior roles at Salesforce, Reach, Achievers, and other software companies.

Core expertise areas:
- Solutions architecture and technical product strategy
- Sales engineering and solution consulting
- Marketing automation (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze)
- CRM systems and data integration
- Technical writing and documentation
- Information architecture
